subject: Cold-chain image bake, signing, and activation notice for IslandBank sealed cluster
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: ops-deploy@islandbank.com, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@islandbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cold-chain image bake, signing, and activation notice for IslandBank sealed cluster

Hi Alex / IslandBank ops team,

Scheduling note: we will perform the cold-chain image bake and signing for your sealed cluster on Wednesday 2028-08-15 (UTC window: 04:00–06:00). This is the pre-staged, physically-signed image that your on-site operator will ingest.

Summary of the plan:
- Bake image: redwood-coldchain-image-20280815.tar.gz (checksummed and signed)
- Signatures: HSM-signed manifest + operator signature envelope
- Courier handoff: Acme Courier will deliver sealed media to your SOC desk (expected 2028-08-15 09:00 local)
- Activation: Operator will follow the attached activation checklist and run attestation step prior to bringing nodes online.

Attachments (prep): manifest-20280815.json (checksums), operator-activation-checklist-20280815.pdf

Open items for your confirmation:
1) Acceptance window for physical handoff (confirm local time & contact)
2) Any extra customs/package handling notes we should include on the courier manifest
3) Your operator's PGP key fingerprint for the final envelope (if you want an additional layer beyond the HSM sig)

Marissa and Jonas are looped for technical and logistics support. I will upload the signed image and signature file to the drive once the bake completes and share the DocuSign envelope for the activation authorization.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Field Deployments
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: operator-activation-checklist-20280815.pdf (PDF, 312 KB), manifest-20280815.json (JSON, 8 KB)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@islandbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-deploy@islandbank.com
Date: Sat, 11 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cold-chain image bake, signing, and activation notice for IslandBank sealed cluster

Neha—

Thanks for the heads up. A few quick answers:
- Handoff window confirmed: 2028-08-15 between 09:00–10:00 local (San Francisco office). Our SOC desk contact is Jordan Lee (mobile: +1-415-555-0199).
- No customs concerns for domestic courier. Please mark package as "SEAL: CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE" on paperwork.
- Operator PGP: 0xA3F4C2D9B7711E3B (we will also have the operator carry ID badge).

One ask: can you provide a short runbook snippet for the attestation step (what to expect and how long it should take)? We'll slot a two-hour maintenance window on our side.

Alex
Lead Cloud Ops, IslandBank
Attachment: ops-contact-card.vcf (vCard)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@islandbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Aug 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cold-chain image bake, signing, and activation notice for IslandBank sealed cluster

Alex / Neha—

Quick technical note on attestation and timings (so the operator team can plan):
- Attestation step: operator runs redwood-verify --manifest manifest-20280815.json --signature redwood-coldchain-image-20280815.tar.gz.sig
- Expected duration: 6–12 minutes on a single operator workstation (depends on hardware); full node bootstrap + KV warmup ~30–45 minutes total per node after activation
- Fallback: if signature verify fails, operator will treat media as quarantined and call our 24/7 ops line. Do not proceed with installation.

I will prepare a 1-page attestation runbook snippet and push to the Drive link. Also tagging Rishi for confirmation on HSM sig policy and revocation timelines.

—Jonas
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: attestation-runbook-snippet.txt (TXT, 4 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@islandbank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cold-chain image bake, signing, and activation notice for IslandBank sealed cluster

Alex —

Thanks for confirming times and the operator PGP fingerprint. Two operational items before bake:
1) DocuSign activation authorization: we need the authorized approver to sign the activation form (this is the final go/no-go). I've opened HS-12345 in our contract tracker and sent a DocuSign link to the approver on file.
2) Courier labeling: Acme has requested the secondary contact for on-site acceptance (Jordan Lee is fine). Please confirm if the package should include an additional on-site phone for same-day acceptance.

Once DocuSign is signed and Jordan confirms the acceptance phone number, we'll perform the bake, HSM-sign the manifest, and transmit the signed image to Acme for sealed delivery.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
Attachment: docusign-activation-envelope.pdf (PDF, 72 KB)

On Tue, Aug 14, 2028 at 09:39, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note: HSM sigs will be produced with the field-ops key and will be timestamped. Revocation window: 24 hrs post-bake unless we detect a signing anomaly. We'll circulate cryptographic audit log entries to IslandBank immediately after bake.
>
> -Rishi
> Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@islandbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cold-chain image bake, signing, and activation notice for IslandBank sealed cluster

All set — DocuSign signed by our CISO (Maria Gomez) at 15:24 local. Jordan confirmed the on-site acceptance phone: +1-415-555-0199.

We received tracking from Acme (tracking: ACME-7784123); ETA to SOC desk 09:10 local. Operator will follow the attestation-runbook-snippet and report the verify command output back to you.

Please push the signed image link and signature to the shared Drive when ready. We'll be on standby for the 04:00–06:00 UTC activation window.

Thanks everyone for the coordination — Alex
